name: @nocobase/plugin-field-lookup
displayName.zh-CN: 数据表字段：查找引用与汇总
description: Lookup field reads a field from a related collection, rollup field aggregates related records (sum/avg/count/min/max). Both are computed at read time.
description.zh-CN: 查找引用字段沿关系读取关联表的字段值，汇总字段对关联记录做聚合（sum/avg/count/min/max），均为读取时计算。
